Here is a list of well known @JoeBiden lies (@grok):

- Civil Rights Arrest: Claimed he was arrested during civil rights protests; no evidence supports this.
- Drove 18-Wheeler: Said he drove a tractor-trailer; he drove a school bus briefly.
- Amtrak Conductor Story: Claimed conductor congratulated him for 1M miles; conductor died before milestone.
- Tree of Life Visit: Said he visited synagogue post-2018 massacre; he only made a phone call.
- Golda Meir Meeting: Claimed meeting during 1967 war as liaison; met in 1973, no liaison role.
- Law School Record: Claimed top-half class rank, full scholarship; was 76th of 85, partial scholarship.
- Delaware House Fire: Exaggerated 2004 fire as near-catastrophic; it was a minor kitchen fire.
- Beau’s Death in Iraq: Implied son died in Iraq; Beau died of cancer in Maryland 2015
- Inflation Rate: Said inflation was 9% when he took office; it was 1.4%.
- Unemployment Rate: Claimed 15% unemployment in 2021; it was 6.3%.
- Job Creation: Claimed 12–15M new jobs; most were post-COVID recoveries.
- Billionaires’ Tax: Said billionaires pay 3–8% tax; actual rate ~23%, based on misleading metric.
- Corporate Taxes: Claimed no big corporations pay zero tax; some still do.
- Student Loan Forgiveness: Said it passed by vote; it was executive action, later blocked.
- COVID Vaccine: Claimed no vaccine available in 2021; 19M doses given pre-inauguration.
- Gas Prices: Said gas was $5 in 2021; average was $2.39.
- No Troop Deaths: Claimed no U.S. troop deaths in his term; 13 died in Afghanistan withdrawal.
- Border Patrol Endorsement: Claimed Border Patrol endorsed him; they did not.
- Trump’s “Suckers and Losers”: Alleged Trump called soldiers this; disputed, lacks evidence.
- Trump’s “Bleach” Comment: Said Trump told people to inject bleach; exaggerated, no direct quote.
- Trump’s “Fine People”: Claimed Trump called neo-Nazis “fine”; omitted Trump’s condemnation.
- Uncle’s Purple Heart: Said he gave uncle a Purple Heart; no evidence exists.
- Georgia Voting Law: Claimed it cut voting hours; it standardized early voting.
- Mexico Starvation: Said kids starved under Trump’s policy; no evidence of starvation.
- Foreign Contracts: Claimed 30% rise under Trump; no evidence.
- Iraq/Afghanistan Visits: Said he visited twice as president; made one Iraq trip.
- Uncle Eaten by Cannibals: Suggested uncle was eaten post-WWII crash; records show ocean crash.
- Real Wages: Claimed take-home pay rose; real wages fell 3.5% by 2023.
- No Hunter Involvement: Claimed no role in Hunter’s business; met associates, per testimony.
- Hunter Did Nothing Wrong: Said investigations cleared Hunter; whistleblowers suggest felonies.
- No China Money: Denied family took Chinese money; records show $1.3M+ received.
- Hunter’s Laptop: Suggested laptop was Russian disinformation; contents later verified
- 1988 Plagiarism: Copied speeches from Kinnock, RFK; led to campaign collapse.
- 1965 Plagiarism: Admitted plagiarizing law review article in law school.
- Mandela Arrest: Claimed arrest visiting Mandela; was briefly detained, not arrested.
- Xi Jinping Travel: Said he traveled 17,000 miles with Xi; figure unsupported
